name: Jeff Staple x Nike Dunk Low Pro SB 'Pigeon'
story_html: The shoe that sparked riots on the streets of New York City—and received a subsequent mention on the front page of the New York Post—the Jeff Staple x Dunk Low Pro SB ‘Pigeon’ released in January 2005 as part of Nike SB’s White Dunk City Series. The low-top features two shades of grey on the upper, accented with a white Swoosh and pops of red on the lining and outsole. The all-important embroidered pigeon adorns the lateral heel
